description: Timed Start/Pause/Resume/Finish action hierarchy (REQ-006; C17, C18; G05; R39, R48, R66, R68, R98) delivered through the shared lifecycle owner TimedWorkoutActions (src/ui/timed-workout-flow.tsx, consolidating the reviewed R7 TimedWorkoutFlow), its pause arithmetic (src/state/timed-lifecycle.ts) and the format controllers EmomBlock, AmrapBlock, ForTimeBlock and LadderBlock, with the shared .clr-timed-actions slot (src/ui/refinements/presentation.css), on the real /workout route (JOURNEY-006), and the accepted gallery states /gallery/refinements?state=ladder-4 and ?state=ladder-12 (reference eded158cfd928d382c9a9409e2c372270312741d) drawing the actual LadderBlock. Every declared case must execute and pass.

check-01.command: node scripts/refinement/run-required-check.mjs --task TASK-006 --check check-01 -- npx vitest run src/ui/timed-workout-flow.test.tsx --passWithNoTests=false

cases.name: TASK-006 timed Start/Pause/Resume/Finish action hierarchy > AC-R006-01 EMOM and AMRAP Start follows the work and prescription and precedes coaching on the real /workout route
TASK-006 timed Start/Pause/Resume/Finish action hierarchy > AC-R006-01 the long ladder keeps its Start near the top, after its identity and cap and before the repetitive rounds, with no second Start

TASK-006 timed Start/Pause/Resume/Finish action hierarchy > AC-C18-01 running controls are a secondary Pause and the format's primary Finish or Finish early, and paused controls a secondary Resume in Pause's place

TASK-006 timed Start/Pause/Resume/Finish action hierarchy > AC-C18-01 Pause freezes the section clock and its cap while the workout clock runs on, and Resume keeps the active time and the remaining window

TASK-006 timed Start/Pause/Resume/Finish action hierarchy > AC-C18-01 Finish ends each format's attempt where it stands — a paused attempt at its pause — and records nothing the format did not already observe

TASK-006 timed Start/Pause/Resume/Finish action hierarchy > JOURNEY-006 recovery: a paused section comes back paused after close and reopen, and a reached cap offers no Resume
TASK-006 timed Start/Pause/Resume/Finish action hierarchy > JOURNEY-006 gallery ladder-4 and ladder-12 draw the actual ladder renderer with the top Start and the Pause/Finish hierarchy
